entry.title: Trump International Hotel and Tower Chicago
entry.note: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms unchanged exact Q546221 ground outline 64594680 and seven independent upper/crown/spire parts. Native +X northeast, +Z southeast; the sign faces the river on +Z and the canopy lies at the southwest Wabash end. Signed asymmetric setbacks, mapped mast positions and entrance datum Y=0 are retained. Intermediate 60/120/200/345 m stages use approximate map heights; crown reaches 357 m and ornamental spire 423.2 m. Exact entry threshold, lower riverwalk and terrain slope are unmeasured. Accepted footprint 2 m / 1 degree; replacement disabled. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
